description.content: Operations for batch querying Azure Monitor metrics across multiple resources

item.name: Azure Monitor Batch query metrics for multiple resources

request.name: Azure Monitor Batch query metrics for multiple resources

description.content: Lists the metric values for multiple resources in a single batch request. All resources must be in the same subscription, region, and resource type. Allows for efficient retrieval of metric data at scale.

query.description: (Required) The start time of the query in ISO 8601 format.
(Required) The end time of the query in ISO 8601 format.
The interval (window size) of the query in ISO 8601 duration format.
(Required) The names of the metrics (comma-separated) to retrieve.
(Required) Metric namespace that contains the requested metric names.
The list of aggregation types (comma-separated) to retrieve.
The maximum number of records to retrieve per resource.
The aggregation to use for sorting results and the direction of the sort.
The $filter used to reduce the set of metric data returned.
Dimension name(s) to rollup results by.

variable.description: (Required) The ID of the target subscription.

response.name: Successful batch request to get metrics for multiple resources.
